title: Constructible module subsheaves over Noetherian rings
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $\Lambda$ a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. For a monomorphism $F\to G$ of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], if $G$ is constructible [def-constructible-constructible], then $F$ is constructible in the same finitely generated module sense. No torsion or finite-ring hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09BH, Proposition 59.74.1 (3), proof of (3); Tag 095E. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03RY.

proof.text: Apply constructible_of_closed_generic. For each closed immersion i:Z -> X, pull back the monomorphism along i. The source-library instance Etale.preservesFiniteLimits_upperStar (WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.UpperLowerStar.Defs), together with the Grothendieck-abelian left Kan extension instance and the categorical fact that finite-limit-preserving functors preserve monomorphisms, supplies Mono of the mapped morphism by typeclass inference. The pulled-back target is constructible by IsConstructibleSheaf.upperStar. This is the ModuleCat-valued inverse image already in the source library; the different SheafOfModules encoding of prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact is not used.
Apply exists_dense_open_of_mono_noetherian to this pulled-back monomorphism. This supplies the dense-open finite local constancy required by the criterion on every closed subscheme.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09BH (3): split generic-neighbourhood argument from closed-subset induction; the induction is proved in Lean using the existing open-closed API. Second reading removes the unused SheafOfModules exactness dependency: monicity is supplied by the source-library ModuleCat pullback instances.

theorem constructible_of_mono_noetherian
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    {F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)}
    (φ : F ⟶ G) [Mono φ] [IsConstructibleSheaf G] :
    IsConstructibleSheaf F
